items.title: The Paladin and Archer traits on the class cards
items.do: Open Aveline's sheet and look at Smite, Judge and Drawing Light (the Actions tab and each card's preview), and her Feature Sworn Blade; then Kaela's Strafe, Slip Away and Harrying Shot, and her Feature Shifting Aim. Use Kaela's Strafe once and look at its chat card.
items.expect: Smite's traits read "Signature · Weapon · Strike · Divine · Paladin · Unfailing", Judge's "Divine · Paladin", Drawing Light's end "Divine · Magical · Paladin"; Strafe's "Weapon · Projectile · Ranged · Strike · Archer", Harrying Shot's end "Strike · Archer"; Slip Away now has a traits line, "Archer". The class word is the Keywords' color, like Divine, with no fill; nothing wraps onto a second line that didn't before. Sworn Blade and Shifting Aim show no trait. The chat card's traits line ends "Archer".

items.title: An existing world's class cards get the trait
items.do: In an existing world, after the update, accept "Update from the compendium" (or run it from the system settings); open Durgan's Lay On Hands and Sylwen's Quick Shots.
items.expect: Lay On Hands reads "Divine · Focus · Paladin", Quick Shots "Weapon · Projectile · Ranged · Strike · Archer"; their class picks (Hallmark Action, Reaction) are kept.

items.title: No "Special Actions" on an NPC; Hurled Goblin and Lay On Hands' words
items.do: As the GM, open the Ogre Chieftain's sheet (Hurled Goblin's card), add an Effect with a "More uses of a Frequency" setting and open its Details; then open Durgan's Lay On Hands.
items.expect: The setting says "its own Round Actions (not the Basic Actions) can be used twice per turn-cycle" (its list line "Own Round Actions twice per turn-cycle"); no "Special" in either; Hurled Goblin's Effect reads "the ogre places the Minion in an empty square adjacent to the target (hit or miss); it takes no damage and triggers no Reactions."; Lay On Hands' Setup button reads "Advance 5 squares".

items.title: A Human's choices lock after level 1
items.do: Log in as a player who owns Aveline (Human Paladin, level 1 confirmed) and click Species: Choices on her Build tab. Then do the same as the GM.
items.expect: As the player: the Species window shows her two Attributes and the +3 side ticked, every option off (hovering one gives the reason: "Locked: your level 1 is confirmed..."), the same reason at the bottom, and only a Close button. As the GM: the options work and Save choices saves them.

items.title: Tend and the Basic Actions' new cards
items.do: In a world from before v0.0.520, refresh the Basic Actions when asked (or Update from the compendium, Basic Actions too), then open Aveline's Actions tab and the HUD's Basic tab.
items.expect: Heal is now Tend (in Utility, same rolls and Rally Point button); Relocate has no Strike trait; Seek's card writes its lines once, with a Use button for 1 AP and one for 2 AP; Crawl's 2 AP block starts with "Requirement: Your Speed is 5 or higher."; Advance's card has its Advance button, and using Advance still moves at once (no card first).

items.title: An NPC's Escalation switch without the default ladder
items.do: Open the Ogre Chieftain's sheet, Builder tab: turn Escalation on (no "Default ladder" switch beside it any more). Start a combat with it and Aveline, and play two rounds.
items.expect: The Ogre's Escalation rises each round as before; the chat line says "Ogre Chieftain's Escalation rises to N." with no "Now: Pressing..." text; its combat line shows the Bloodied +1 and Strained +1 hooks and the Escalation marks, but no Pressing / Relentless / Second Wind rungs; its first attack each round gets no free Boon. The sheet opens without an error.

items.title: No Ruler line in Designer mode
items.do: Turn on Designer mode, open Aveline's Smite card on her sheet, then use Smite against the Orc Warrior.
items.expect: No "Ruler" line on the card or under the chat card (the Odds and the Automation lines stay in Designer mode).

items.title: The four playtest creatures' sheets
items.do: In a new world (or after importing them again from the NPCs compendium), open the Goblin Sneak, the Grave Wisp, the Orc Warrior and the Ogre Chieftain.
items.expect: Goblin Sneak: Minion, CV 30, 2 ticks (a "Ticks 2/2" bar, no Vigor or Resolve), AD 13, WD 12, Weapon and Power +2, Speed 6, Shiv, Jeer, Knife in the Back, Shriek and Scatter. Grave Wisp: Grunt, CV 50, Vigor 6, Resolve 12, AD 12, WD 14, Speed 6, its new portrait, the damage line "Immunity Cold · Resistance Psychic 3 · Weakness Holy 3", Drifting, Slipping Touch, Guttering Glance, Pass Through, Dying Flare. Orc Warrior: Standard, Vigor 22, Resolve 14, 13 / 13, Speed 5. Ogre Chieftain: Elite, CV 200, Vigor 44, Resolve 28, AD 14, WD 12, Large, Reach 2, Steadiness 1, Speed 5, no Escalation; Crushing Grip, Roar, Great Sweep, Hurled Goblin, Crack the Ground, Backhand. None of the old cards (Rusty Knife, Club, Rally the Tribe...).

items.title: Rev 2 · Point Out on a creature Unsensed for another reason than Hide
items.do: In a combat, give Kaela the Blinded status and put a Goblin Sneak more than 10 squares from her, in bright light where Sylwen sees it. Use Sylwen's Point Out on the goblin (Tier 2: pick Kaela). Move the goblin one square. Then use the Goblin Sneak's Hide.
items.expect: Before: Kaela's roll against the goblin skips it (Unsensed). After Point Out: a line "Kaela perceives Goblin Sneak as Hidden (was Unsensed)"; her Actions against it are Doomed (Hidden), not skipped. After the goblin moves, it is still Hidden to her. After the goblin uses Hide, it is Unsensed to her again. A goblin Hidden from Hide that Sylwen herself perceives only as Hidden stays Hidden for Kaela (never better than Sylwen).

items.title: A thick wall blocks Hearing
items.do: In a combat, put the Orc Warrior behind a wall, within 10 squares of Kaela and out of her sight. Open that wall's settings (double-click it) and tick the new "Thick wall (2d12)" box under the Sound restriction, then untick it.
items.expect: Ticked: the orc's sound ripple goes from Kaela's view and her Actions skip it (Unsensed); the box shows ticked when the settings are opened again. Unticked: the ripple is back (Hidden through a thin wall).

items.title: A Minion's ticks, for the GM and the players
items.do: Put two Goblin Sneaks on the map in a combat. Look at them as the GM, then log in as a player (or use a player's view). Right-click one goblin for the Token HUD; select it for the system's HUD.
items.expect: Each goblin shows two red pips at the top of its token, for the players too. The HUD shows one bar "2/2 ticks" (two segments); the Token HUD has one box with 2 in it (type -1: one pip goes; +1: it comes back).

items.title: Squads of 2
items.do: Put four Goblin Sneaks in a combat and open the Initiative window.
items.expect: Two squads of two (never three in one); putting three in one squad shows "3 in squad (book: ≤2)".

items.title: An Effect can name [Paladin] Actions
items.do: As the GM, add an Effect to Aveline with a "Boons and Banes" setting (1 Boon) whose trait filter is "all of: Paladin" (the picker's Keywords group); roll her Smite, then her Basic Attack. Remove the Effect after.
items.expect: The picker's Keywords list Archer, Divine, Fear, Focus, Magical, Paladin, Subtle, Unfailing. Smite's roll dialog has the Boon; the Basic Attack's doesn't.

items.title: You choose the Attribute you roll
items.do: Kaela targets the Orc Warrior and uses Trip.
items.expect: the roll dialog has two Roll buttons, "Roll · Instinct +N" and "Roll · Body +N" (the higher first); the second one rolls at once with Body, against the orc's Body DC (the chat card says Body).

items.title: The Basic Attack never uses the Fists
items.do: Aveline stows her weapons (both hands empty) and uses Basic Attack, then the Fists Basic Action.
items.expect: Basic Attack is refused with a note ("holds no weapon ... use the Fists Basic Action"); Fists works as before. With her sword in hand, Basic Attack offers only the sword.

items.title: Drawing Light isn't Doomed for being Engaged
items.do: Durgan stands next to the Orc Warrior and uses Drawing Light on it.
items.expect: no "You are Engaged (Doomed)" chip in the roll dialog (Kaela's bow shot from next to the orc still gets it).

items.title: Cornered: 1 Boon on the Bloodied orc's Shove
items.do: Damage the Orc Warrior to Bloodied (22 Vigor damage), then use its Shove on Durgan. Do it again after healing it below 22.
items.expect: Bloodied: the roll dialog shows a "Cornered" Boon, on; the roll has it. Not Bloodied: no Cornered chip. Its Trip never gets it.

items.title: Knife in the Back needs a flank
items.do: With a Goblin Sneak, target Kaela and use Knife in the Back, once with another goblin on Kaela's opposite side and once alone.
items.expect: Flanking: no warning, the flanking Field Boon in the dialog. Alone: the dialog warns "doesn't flank Kaela (its Requirement). Used anyway."

items.title: Shake Off's card: the book's Save line and three Tiers
items.do: Look at Shake Off on Durgan's sheet, its hover card and the HUD's card. Give Durgan a Lingering (the Orc Warrior's Barbed Javelin, Tier 3) and use Shake Off on him; click the card's "The target's Save" button.
items.expect: Every card reads Save (the better of the Lingering's two Attributes, against DC 13 or the DC the Lingering writes) with the button at its end, then Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3 as three lines; no paragraph repeating them. The button rolls Durgan's Save against the Lingering, as before.

items.title: Empowered's die deals the damage you choose
items.do: Make Aveline Empowered (the Conditions) and use Binding Light on the Orc Warrior until a Tier 2 or 3; roll its damage. Then, next turn, Empowered again, use her Basic Attack.
items.expect: Binding Light deals two kinds (Vigor from the Longsword, Resolve Holy): the bottom bar asks which one the 1d6! deals, and the die joins that one. The Basic Attack deals one kind: no question, the die joins it.

items.title: The Basic Attack's Critical row
items.do: With Aveline, make Basic Attacks against the Orc Warrior until one is a Critical (or set the dice), first with nothing else, then with Smite's Holy damage on the same attack.
items.expect: The card shows "Critical: [V] 1d10!" under Tier 3. On the Critical, the pick bar asks "Its 1d10!: choose the damage type, or don't apply it": one option, her sword's Slash ([V] 1d10! Sl), then Don't apply; with Smite, a second option [R] 1d10! Ho. The die is rolled with the chosen type and explodes; the damage card shows the Critical line; the Encounter Log counts the Critical as before.

items.title: The creatures' Critical rows
items.do: With the Goblin Sneak, roll Shiv against Kaela until a Critical; then the Orc Warrior's Hamstringing Axe against Durgan; then the Grave Wisp's Guttering Glance against Sylwen.
items.expect: Each card shows its own Critical row ([V] 1d10! Pi, [V] 1d10! Sl, [R] 1d10! Ps). On the Critical the pick bar asks "Apply: [V] 1d10! Pi." / Don't apply; the 1d10 explodes on a 10; the damage is the row's pool and subtype.

items.title: A Critical on Shiv offers its row; no default row
items.do: With the Goblin Sneak, roll Shiv against Kaela until a Critical (or set the dice). Then, on the Goblin Sneak's sheet, make a new Action, give it a Tier 2 of [V] 1d4 Pi and tick "Basic attack" in its sheet.
items.expect: On the Critical the pick bar asks "Apply: [V] 1d10! Pi." / Don't apply; applied, the 1d10 explodes on a 10 (the face counts 9 and is rolled again) and deals Pierce to Kaela's Vigor. The new Action's Critical row stays empty when "Basic attack" is ticked: nothing fills it, and a Critical with it adds nothing.

items.title: A Minor enemy's Empowered die explodes
items.do: Outside a combat, give the Grave Wisp Empowered by hand from the Conditions, then roll its Slipping Touch against Sylwen until a Tier 2 or 3, and again until the Empowered die shows a 6 (or set the dice). Then the same with a Goblin Sneak (Empowered from the Conditions) and its Shiv against Kaela.
items.expect: The damage card has the Empowered die as 1d6! (Cold for the wisp, Pierce for the goblin); on a 6 it counts 5 and is rolled again, the exploded face shown, as it does for the Orc Warrior. The Tier's own 1d4 or 1d6 still never explodes (it writes no !).

items.title: Damage removes a Minion's ticks by the Tier
items.do: With Aveline, use Word of Radiance (or any Save Action) on two goblins.
items.expect: Each goblin's own Save, turned over: a Tier 1 Save removes 3 (Down), a Tier 2 removes 2, a Tier 3 with no damage removes none.

items.title: Lingerings of different subtypes run together; Shake Off ends one
items.do: Give Durgan a Lingering 1d4 Pi (the Orc Warrior's Barbed Javelin, Tier 3), then a Lingering 1d6 Fi (by hand from the Conditions), then another Lingering 1d4 Pi. End his turn. Then use Shake Off on him.
items.expect: He keeps two Lingerings: the Piercing one (the second Piercing one, not higher, leaves the first) and the Fire one. At the end of his turn each deals its own damage card. Shake Off asks in the bottom bar which Lingering it ends (both listed by name); the Save uses that Lingering's Attributes and DC, and only that one ends (or is halved on a Tier 2).

items.title: A dead creature doesn't get in the way
items.do: In a combat, take a Goblin Sneak to 0 with Aveline (no Unconscious status on it). Advance Durgan through its square, then end a movement in it. Then give another goblin at 0 the Unconscious status and move Durgan through it.
items.expect: The dead goblin's square costs nothing extra and Durgan can stop in it (the movement area includes it). The Unconscious goblin's square costs double and Durgan can't end there.

items.title: Charge stops at the weapon's normal Range
items.do: Durgan (Arming Sword) Charges an Orc Warrior 5 squares away. Then Sylwen, with her Hunting Bow in hand, Charges an orc about 16 squares away; then with only her Dagger in hand.
items.expect: Durgan stops adjacent, as before. Sylwen with the bow stops on the first square from which the orc is within 12 squares (the bow's normal Range), the line and texts saying "in Range"; an orc already within 12 is "too close". With the Dagger, if it is a Thrown weapon the bottom bar first asks "Dagger (in hand)" or "Dagger (thrown)", and she stops where that Range reaches.

items.title: One square of Difficult Terrain always
items.do: Draw a Difficult Terrain region next to Kaela. Make her Prone and Crawl (1 square) into it. Then, standing, use Advance and move 2 squares in the open and try the next square into the region with 1 left.
items.expect: The Crawl's area shows the square in the region and she enters it; the Crawl is spent, no AP more. The Advance with 1 square left can't enter it for free (it costs 2: a further AP is spent, as before).

items.title: A creature Down but still fighting holds its space
items.do: Durgan is Dying and keeps fighting; as the GM, drag the Orc Warrior through Durgan's square. Then Durgan collapses (Unconscious) and you drag it again.
items.expect: first, the move is refused (his space blocks, like any standing creature); after he collapses, the orc can pass through his square as Difficult Terrain (never ending there).

items.title: A Collision removes 1 tick, never a second one for the same Action
items.do: With Durgan, Shove a Goblin Sneak into a wall (Tier 2). Then give a fresh goblin 3 ticks (its Builder tab, Frame, Ticks 3), catch it beside a wall with Aveline's Word of Radiance (until its result against it removes 2 ticks) and click the card's Pushed button to push it into the wall.
items.expect: The Shove's Collision removes 1 tick (the Shove dealt it no damage). Word of Radiance's result removes its ticks once (1 left) and the Collision of its own Push (clicked from its card) removes none.

items.title: The Grave Wisp's Drifting
items.do: In a combat, drag the Grave Wisp through Aveline's space and through another wisp's, then try to end its movement in Aveline's square.
items.expect: The movement passes through both spaces with no extra cost (no Difficult Terrain); ending in a creature's space is refused. An Orc Warrior can't pass through Aveline's space (it blocks).

items.title: Shifting Aim on another creature's turn
items.do: On the Orc Warrior's turn, push Sylwen 1 square (the GM's Alt-drag, or the orc's Shove), then use a [Ranged, Strike] of Sylwen's during that turn (Snap Shot if its Trigger fits, or her Basic Attack from the sheet). Then a second one in the same turn.
items.expect: The first roll dialog shows Shifting Aim's Field Boon (on); the second doesn't (a Strike since). With no move during that turn, no Boon.

items.title: Judge's re-Judge when the Judged creature goes Down is a Reaction
items.do: Aveline Judges an Orc Warrior; take it Down. Click the message's Judge button with another orc targeted. Then do it again with Aveline Staggered.
items.expect: The message's button reads "Judge (0R)"; the card it posts says 0R and the orc is Judged. Staggered: the dialog warns "Aveline is Staggered: no Reactions until it ends. Used anyway." The start-of-encounter message's button still reads "Judge (0 AP)".

items.title: Feint's Critical blocks only the Reactions you trigger
items.do: Kaela Feints the Bloodied Orc Warrior with a Critical (Designer mode: Force a Tier, or roll until one), then hits it; then Sylwen hits it.
items.expect: Kaela's hit: Blood for Blood is not offered (a note: Feinted); Sylwen's hit: Blood for Blood is offered against Sylwen as usual.

items.title: Blood for Blood is offered by itself
items.do: Make the Orc Warrior Bloodied with Sylwen's Basic Attack from 2 squares away, then hit it again with Vigor damage; then hit it with Resolve damage (Durgan's Drawing Light), and once from 4 squares away.
items.expect: The Vigor hit that Bloodies it (and the next) offers Blood for Blood (Use / Pass); Use: Advance up to 2, then the Basic attack button with 1 Bane takes the axe when Sylwen is in reach (the javelin when she isn't; both: a pick window). The Resolve hit and the hit from 4 squares offer nothing.

items.title: An NPC's Rally Point is a quarter of its Health
items.do: Deal 10 damage to a Grave Wisp and 20 to the Ogre Chieftain. With Durgan, use Lay On Hands on the wisp, then on the ogre.
items.expect: The wisp heals 5 (a quarter of 18, rounded up) and the ogre 18 (a quarter of 72); neither spends anything. An Orc Warrior would heal 9.

items.title: Dying Flare when the Grave Wisp would go Down
items.do: Bring the Grave Wisp to 1 Health, put Aveline and an Orc Warrior next to it, and hit it with Kaela.
items.expect: Before the damage lands, the Reactions message offers Dying Flare (an Interrupt). Use: the 1 Emanation around the wisp, an Instinct Save for Aveline and the orc (DC 13; the wisp itself is not in it); a Tier 1 gives Hindered (EoT). Then the held damage lands and the wisp goes Down (nothing is saved).

items.title: Shriek and Scatter when a goblin goes Down
items.do: Three Goblin Sneaks within 6 squares of each other; end one goblin's turn with 1 AP kept. Take another goblin Down with Sylwen.
items.expect: The goblin with a kept AP is offered Shriek and Scatter (it has no Reaction Point: the AP pays); Use: Evade 1 and the Jeer button. A goblin with no AP left shows in the "No Reactions" line. A goblin farther than 6 squares isn't offered it.

items.title: The Ogre's Backhand doesn't stop the mover
items.do: Move Durgan (Advance) into a square adjacent to the Ogre Chieftain, with movement to spare. Then Evade into an adjacent square with Aveline.
items.expect: Durgan's movement is offered Backhand (a Trigger, no Move back on the message); Use: the 1 Blunt damage button and Pushed 2. Durgan still has the rest of his movement. Aveline's Evade offers nothing.

items.title: Crack the Ground leaves a broken floor
items.do: With the Ogre Chieftain, use Crack the Ground (aim the Line 3 at Aveline and Durgan in a row). Then move Aveline and the ogre across the Line.
items.expect: The Line 3 starts from the ogre's space; each creature in it makes an Instinct Save against DC 13 ([V] 5 + 2d8 / 3 + 1d8 / nothing). The Line stays on the map; moving into it costs double for Aveline and for the ogre too; it is gone when the encounter ends.

items.title: Stabilizing rolls nothing; damage while Unconscious and Down rolls the Table
items.do: Durgan is Dying and collapsed (Unconscious). End his turns until his Body Check is a Tier 3; on another Dying try, damage him while he is Unconscious.
items.expect: the Tier 3 says he stabilizes, with no roll on the Dying Table; damage while he is Unconscious and Down rolls the Dying Table (an Unconscious Durgan who wasn't Dying becomes Dying or Shattered by his Dominant Damage first).

items.title: An old world's Minions
items.do: In your playtest world, open an old Goblin Sneak (from before this version), then import the four creatures again from the NPCs compendium.
items.expect: The old goblin now shows 2 ticks (its old damage read as ticks lost: it may show Down); the imported ones are the new sheets above.

items.title: The Encounter Log names a fight by its cost in Rally Points a PC
items.do: Start a combat with the four pregens, Aveline, Durgan, Sylwen and Kaela, against two Orc Warriors. Let the orcs deal damage to the PCs' Health (some to each), heal one PC with a Rally Point, then open the Encounter Log; afterwards apply damage by hand until the party has taken about 50, then about 85, then about 110 in all (count a healed point too).
items.expect: The top line reads "Party: N% HP · X.X RP a PC · Easy" (one decimal; X.X is the damage that reached Health, healed or not, divided by 34, which is 9 + 9 + 8 + 8 for the four pregens' Rally Points). The name follows the cost: up to 1.25 Easy, above it up to 2 Normal (about 50 taken: 1.5), above 2 up to 3 Hard (about 85: 2.5), above 3 Deadly (about 110: 3.2); no "Trivial". The Health table's legend reads "Difficulty by cost in Rally Points a PC: Easy up to 1¼ · Normal up to 2 · Hard up to 3 · Deadly above 3". Copy for Analysis: its "Party Health Cost" line ends with the same "X.X RP a PC · name". The look is as before (the same label, colored by the name).
